note: Missing `id`. There is no default credential to return, and an absent id must not read as 'any'.
Empty `id`. minLength guards the shape that would otherwise reach a maintainer's storage layer as a prefix scan.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false catches `includeArchived`. Get takes no modifiers; an archived credential is never returned.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
